product.title: Private NASA Space Center Day Trip with Houston City Tour

description.text: Pair a Houston city overview through River Oaks with a guided Space Center Houston day trip on a private outing that includes NASA tram access and a meal stop. The longer itinerary suits visitors who want city context and NASA exhibits without arranging separate transfers. Stops include River Oaks, Space Center Houston, NASA Tram Tour, BBQ Dinner Stop. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Houston skyline views, bayou corridors, and neighborhood landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Houston who want a guided Space City experience without coordinating meeting points or attraction entrances on their own.
